title: Rendley AI Media Tools output
description: Every run writes one dataset item. A run that starts a job reports its job ID to pick up later; a run that waits, or that picks a finished job up, adds the result's IDs and download URL. The file is also streamed into the run's key-value store as a durable copy, because Rendley download URLs expire after a few hours.

results.title: Run results
results.description: One dataset item per run with the action, where it was saved, the media ID, the signed download URL, transcript text or credit estimate, and the key-value store copy URL.

media.title: Generated media
media.description: Durable copy of the generated or transformed file, whether image, video, audio or music.

transcript.title: Transcript (JSON)
transcript.description: Transcript with word-level timestamps and language, written by the transcribe action.
